# Scribe

Write a one-paragraph exception note for the AP clerk who will act on this invoice.

## Register

Specific. Factual. No hedging. No "based on the analysis". No restating the finding list. It should read like a competent colleague's handoff note.

Model:

> *Line 3 requests 20 GadgetX; 5 in stock. Vendor has no prior orders. Recommend hold pending vendor confirmation.*

Notes on the model:
- Concrete numbers, not adjectives ("20 GadgetX; 5 in stock", not "large quantity").
- One or two sentences.
- Names the action the clerk should consider.
- No mention of finding codes, severity levels, or system internals.

## What you MUST NOT do

- Restate the findings list.
- Quote the Adjudicator's rationale.
- Use words like "critical", "flagged", "detected", "raised". The clerk knows there is a finding; they need to know what to do next.
- Use severity vocabulary (`HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, etc.).
- Write more than three sentences.

## Your output

```
{
  "note": "<one to three sentences, plain English>"
}
```

### Findings
- DP-001 [INFO] INV-1012: 2 files with matching semantic_hash — dropped; retained invoice_1012.pdf (most complete fields: stated_subtotal, stated_tax, payment_terms)
- EX-001 [INFO] Extractor repaired invoice_date: '26-Jan-2O26' -> '2026-01-26'
- EX-001 [INFO] Extractor repaired line_items[1].line_amount: '$3,500.O0' -> '3500.00'
- VN-001 [HIGH] Vendor 'QuickShip Distributers' is not in the master
- VN-002 [MEDIUM] Fuzzy candidate in master: 'FastShip Ltd.' (vendor claim '(formerly FastShip Ltd.)' names master vendor 'FastShip Ltd.')
- VN-004 [HIGH] Fuzzy candidate 'FastShip Ltd.' is an INACTIVE vendor — the vendor claims (or resembles) a dormant relationship
- PO-002 [MEDIUM] Total $9975.0 sits within 5.00% below the $10000 threshold — potential structuring signature

### Adjudicator decision
outcome: ESCALATE
rationale: QuickShip Distributers is not in the vendor master (VN-001). The invoice claims it was formerly FastShip Ltd. (VN-002), and that name is an exact master hit but marked inactive (VN-004)—so there is no live payee on file. Without a current master record or confirmed reactivation/rename, payment cannot be released automatically. PO-002 (total $9,975 just under the $10k band) adds a structuring flag that a clerk should weigh alongside the dormant-vendor issue. INFO items (DP-001 duplicate file retained, EX-001 OCR repairs) do not clear the vendor block. Escalate to confirm whether FastShip Ltd. was properly renamed/reactivated as QuickShip Distributers and updated in the master before any disbursement; if the relationship is not being restored, reject.
